input_oneliner: 71F POD2 knee arthroplasty, Foley in, T 38.6 overnight, mild cough, no complaints otherwise

reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Tachypnea is the vital sign most predictive of pneumonia; entirely normal vitals lower probability (Metlay 1997 RCE)

reference_targets_freetext.item: Focal consolidation: egophony, bronchial breath sounds, dullness to percussion; Focal crackles
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Asymmetric consolidation findings are the best bedside predictors of pneumonia (Metlay 1997 RCE); focal crackles folded in as the same construct

reference_targets_freetext.item: Inspect surgical wound for erythema, warmth, drainage, dehiscence, and tenderness beyond the incision
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Surgical site infection is common by day 2-5 and is entirely a bedside diagnosis

reference_targets_freetext.item: Costovertebral angle (CVA) tenderness and suprapubic tenderness
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Catheter-associated UTI needs findings beyond bacteriuria; flank tenderness raises pyelonephritis

reference_targets_freetext.item: Ask: sputum, pleuritic chest pain, dysuria, flank pain, rigors, new medications, transfusion
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Localizing symptom review directs the differential and identifies drug or transfusion fever

reference_targets_freetext.item: Calf circumference asymmetry >3 cm, calf tenderness, unilateral swelling
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Post-operative immobility makes DVT a real cause of low-grade fever

should_not_recommend: Empiric broad-spectrum antibiotics before source exam
Attributing the fever to atelectasis without a source examination

perturbation_pair.input_oneliner: 71F POD2 sigmoid colectomy, Foley in, T 38.6 overnight, mild cough, no complaints otherwise
perturbation_pair.expected_change: Intra-abdominal abscess or anastomotic leak enters the top differential; abdominal exam for distension and peritoneal signs becomes must-have and wound inspection stays must-have; focal consolidation signs and respiratory rate drop to should-still-include; ask about flatus, bowel function, and drain output rises.
